image.image_caption: This diagram illustrates an agriculture monitoring and controlling system. The left side depicts farm elements: a farmer tending to crops, a drone, servers, sensors, and a router, connected to a cloud icon. The right side details the system architecture. Under Transformation, there's Streaming Processing (AWS Glue) and a Streaming Platform (AWS Kinesis). Under Serving, there's Real-time Analytics (SageMaker), an AI/ML System (ML Flow), a Gen AI (LLM + RAG), and a BI Tool which includes Power BI, Tableau, and Reporting (Gradio/Streamlit). Data Storage is handled by AWS S3, feeding into a Data Warehouse (AWS Redshift) and a Data Lake (Athena). Reverse ELT and Farm Management Services are also components. The system serves clients through Web, Mobile, Chat Bot, and IoT Edge Devices.

This timeline chart illustrates the growth and milestones of VNS from September 2024 to December 2025. The timeline starts in September 2024 with the decision to establish VNS. In October 2024, there were 3 members. A key milestone occurred on November 15, 2024, when VNS was licensed, indicated by a star. By December 25, 2024, the first office was established with 8 members. The membership grew steadily through 2025, reaching 15 members in January, 32 in February, 55 in March, 81 in April, and 100 in May. The projection for December 2025 is 500 to 600 members.

This organizational chart illustrates a company's structure, headed by the CEO - Tai Pham. Reporting directly to the CEO is the Managing Director, Jessica Quach, who oversees two main divisions. The Technical Director, Kevin Le, reports to the Managing Director and also has a dotted-line reporting relationship to the CEO. The two main divisions are Corporate Services and Technology Solutions. The Corporate Services division includes HRBP Manager Phuong Nguyen, TA Manager Hoan Bui, C&B Manager Tan Le, Admin Lead Tho Bui, Marketing Manager Tu Kieu, an FIS Manager, and ITS Manager Hai Nguyen. The Technology Solutions division, led by the Technical Director, is composed of three units: DSU Head, AIS Head, and CSS Head. The DSU unit includes roles like Backend, Frontend, Mobile, QA/QC, DevOps, UXUI, PM, BA/PO, and Designer. The AIS unit includes Data Scientist, Data Engineer, and Data Analytic roles. The CSS unit covers roles such as Cyber Security, Risk & Compliance, Security Auditor, Security Operations Center Analyst, and Security Engineer.

Underneath DELIVERY are five main units: Delivery Solution Unit (DSU), AI Insights Solutions Center (AIS), Cyber Securities Solutions Center (CSS), IOT Center (IOT), and Technical Support Department (TSD). DSU has two branches: Agriculture and Exploration. Agriculture contains Minister Dashboard, Smart Farm, and Traceability Platform. Exploration contains Manufacture and Dynamic Solutions. Manufacture further contains Zero Carbon Score, RPA, and Safering. AIS includes Agriculture, Biometric/OCR, and Finance. CSS includes Security Consultant and Fraud/Risk Management System. IOT Center (IOT) has VNS ERP, and Websites, Branding. Technical Support Department (TSD) includes VNS ERP, ITS, and DevOps/SRE. ITS further includes IT and ISO/CMMI Audit team. DevOps/SRE has QA/QC and Designer. Designer has UX/UI.

This document outlines various benefits, categorized into Total cash, Benefit in kind (Non-cash), and Engagement activity. Total cash benefits include Salary, Bonus, Allowances, Overtime Pay, and Loyalty. Salary components are Basic salary (competitive), Promotion (ad-hoc or annual), Review (annual, applied on Apr), and Adjustment (ad-hoc). Bonus categories are 13th month (guarantee), Incentives (follow KPIs, and only to certain roles), Annual performance (follow PA, paid on Apr), Referral (as campaign), and Project bonus (Occationlly, paid next month). Allowances include Allowance, and Overtime Pay includes Upon advanced approval with a note about Following project plan. Loyalty is detailed by tenure: 3 years (1M), 5 years (1.5M), and 10 years (2M). Benefit in kind (Non-cash) encompasses Healthcare and Leaves. Healthcare includes Healthcare premium and Health-check with Premium package. Leaves include Statutory day off, with details about carried over days, service milestone, and special days off (Christmas and 2nd half of 31 Dec). Other supports like Pre-paid phone card are also listed. Engagement activity includes Daily/Weekly, Monthly, Yearly, and Occasionally activities. Daily/Weekly activities are Happy hours and Snacks and cafeteria. Monthly activities include Monthly team eating out and Chat with CEO / Town Hall. Yearly activities are YEP, Company Trip, and TET gift. Occasionally activities include Welcome Kit and Occasional gifts. The 'Others' category lists Personal event supports (Wedding gift, Baby gift), Parking supports (Bike and car pack at DH), Training and development, and Bussiness Networking (reimbursement).
